description: Frances Halden [?] and Helen Jones standing outside, holding a large skull between them. Handwritten in pencil on verso: "Longhorn Skull for Ms O'Keeffe / Frances Halder [?] and / Helen Jones on the / Halden's [?] adobe / walled terrace - / (Sun shadows through / latticed roof on walls / behind)".
